0:
general_settings:
  store_model_in_db: true
litellm_settings:
  drop_params: true
  additional_drop_params: ["context_management"]
  check_provider_endpoint: true
  callbacks:
    - prometheus

source_directories:
    - /mailbackup
repositories:
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_DEFAULT_DOMAIN}//opt/local/mailbackup
    label: onsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_OFFSITE_DOMAIN}//opt/backup/mailbackup
    label: offsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
ssh_command: ssh -i /home/user/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no
archive_name_format: mailbackup-{now}

while true; do
  /app/ersatztv-playout-generator --lineup /config/lineup.json --channel 1 --content-folder /data/video/musicvideos || true
  sleep 172800
done
